summary: The comment argues that parents should have primary authority over their children’s online exposure and calls for the FCC to require full transparency from schools regarding internet filtering policies so parents can oversee content.

claims.requested_action: mandate full transparency of school filtering policies
claims.argument: Parents must be able to see what content is allowed on school networks to protect their children’s development.
